songs.title: Hot Cross Buns - Right Hand & Rhythm
songs.description: Preparation: open high E, steady beats and rests.

songs.title: Hot Cross Buns - First Fretted Notes
songs.description: At your own pace: open high E, then frets 2 and 4.

songs.title: Hot Cross Buns - First Musical Phrase
songs.description: The real opening: 4, 2, 0. Play, rest, then repeat.

songs.title: Hot Cross Buns - The Quicker Middle
songs.description: Four open-string eighths, then four eighths at fret 2.

songs.title: Hot Cross Buns - The Complete Tune
songs.description: The complete four-bar melody, played three times.

songs.title: Hot Cross Buns - First Bass
songs.description: Thumb on open low E, then the familiar melody. One note at a time. 50 BPM.

songs.title: Hot Cross Buns - Alternating Bass
songs.description: Alternate open low E and A-string fret 2 (B) under the familiar melody. 50 BPM.

songs.title: Hot Cross Buns - Melody Across Strings
songs.description: Keep high E frets 4/2; move melody E to B-string fret 5. Familiar E/B bass. 45 BPM.

levels.title: First Notes & Rhythm
levels.description: Open strings, your first fretted notes and a steady rhythm.

sublevels.title: Hot Cross Buns
sublevels.description: Your first solo melody, then thumb bass and two notes together.
